arrangement.title: Quick note switches and held bends
decisions: The accepted 50 BPM preview is imported exactly: 96 presses and 24 bend changes across nine continuous holds. Fast turns use separate notes; rhythmic taps remain distinct.

Each live event references its event ID in the approved arrangement. Original MIDI event IDs and screenshot note IDs remain derivation provenance; the original binary and normalized inventory are unchanged.
Bend eligibility was selected at 45 BPM, then the same beat-relative notes and curves were played at the approved 50 BPM. No new threshold calculation changes the accepted arrangement.
Ten stable Honks cover the starting pitches. Either hand can play; all bends within one hold use one Trigger press.
Every sound uses the ordinary Honk instrument, voice engine, vowel, gain, envelope, and mixer. Only tuning, note timing and wrist bend are guided; preview audio and synthesis are not loaded.
The original MIDI was reconstructed from the user's edited GarageBand screenshots; its timing remains approximate relative to that visual source.

lessons.title: Opening pulses and first turn
lessons.goal: Keep the opening taps distinct. Switch notes through the quick rise and ending descent; hold Trigger through the slower bends in between.

lessons.title: Low pulses and answering phrase
lessons.goal: Keep the low repeated pulses crisp. Play the quick descending notes separately, then keep C♯ held through all the answering bends and returns to neutral.

lessons.title: High repeated notes and the crest
lessons.goal: Keep the high repeated notes distinct. Hold the G♯ to F♯ bend, then switch notes through the quick crest and descent.

lessons.title: Fast turns with fewer presses
lessons.goal: Hold E as it bends up to F♯. Use separate presses for the fast falling and rising turns that follow.

lessons.title: Answer and return
lessons.goal: Play these quick turns as separate notes. Keep the returning E pulses distinct and follow the squares for each new press.

lessons.title: Rising and falling holds
lessons.goal: Use separate notes for the quick turns. Keep the repeated E accents, then hold through its slower falling and rising bends. Keep the final E♭ to C♯ bend held.

lessons.title: Closing phrase
lessons.goal: Hold the opening C♯ through the answering bends. Switch notes through the quick descent, preserve the low pulses, and hold the final F♯ through E to E♭ before the two C♯ presses.

lessons.title: Complete guided performance
lessons.goal: Play the whole section at 50 BPM. Switch notes through the quick turns and keep Trigger held through each slower bend phrase, including returns to neutral. Keep the rhythmic accents. Either hand works.

recording.instructions: Play at 50 BPM. Use the squares to switch notes through quick turns. When the bend gauge appears, keep Trigger held through the entire bend phrase and every return to neutral. Release between separate notes and preserve repeated accents. Either hand works.
